verses: Qasam hai enjeer ki aur zaitoon ki
Aur uss aman walay shehar ki
Yaqeenan hum ney insan ko behtareen soorat mein peda kiya
Phir ussay neechon say neecha ker diya
Lekin jo log eman laye aur (phir) nek amal kiye to unn kay liye aisa ajar hai jo kabhi khatam na hoga
Pus tujhay abb roz jaza kay jhutlanay per kaun si cheez aamaadah kerti hai
Kiya Allah Taalaa (sab) hakimon ka haakim nahi hai
